Issue 06:
# 06 — Checkout form + create-payment-intent Edge Function

Status: needs-triage
Type: AFK

## What to build

Build the checkout form and the `create-payment-intent` Supabase Edge Function. The form collects customer and shipping details. On submit, it calls the Edge Function which validates the cart server-side, writes a pending order to Supabase, and returns a Stripe `clientSecret`. After this slice the full order record exists in the DB before any payment is taken.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `CheckoutForm` collects: full name, email, street address, city, postal code, country
- [ ] All fields are required; form does not submit if any are empty
- [ ] On submit, form calls `create-payment-intent` Edge Function with cart items and customer data
- [ ] Edge Function fetches product prices from DB — never trusts client-provided prices
- [ ] Edge Function returns 400 if any `product_id` is not found in the DB
- [ ] Edge Function returns 400 if any item has `is_available = false`
- [ ] Edge Function writes one `orders` row with `status: order_received` and all customer/shipping fields
- [ ] Edge Function writes one `order_items` row per cart item with `price_at_purchase` from DB
- [ ] Edge Function creates a Stripe PaymentIntent in EUR and returns `clientSecret`
- [ ] Edge Function does NOT create a Stripe PaymentIntent if any validation fails
- [ ] `VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`, `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` configured in the correct environments
- [ ] Tests: all Edge Function validation and DB-write behaviours

## Blocked by

- 01 — Supabase schema + project config
- 05 — Cart + CartDrawer

plan.sprint_goal: Build the CheckoutForm UI and create-payment-intent Edge Function so a complete pending order record is written to the DB before any payment is taken

dev1.task: Build the CheckoutForm component inside src/pages/Checkout.jsx. Render a form with required fields: full name, email, street address, city, postal code, country. On submit: read cart items from CartContext (shape: [{id, name, price, image_url, quantity}]), POST to the Supabase Edge Function URL (/functions/v1/create-payment-intent) with body {items: [{product_id: item.id, quantity: item.quantity}], customer: {name, email, street, city, postal_code, country}}. On success, receive clientSecret, load Stripe via src/lib/stripe.js, and mount a Stripe PaymentElement inside the page for the shopper to complete payment. Disable the submit button and show an inline error if any field is empty (no submission). Show a clear error message if the Edge Function returns 400 (e.g. 'One or more items are no longer available'). Do not trust or send client-side prices. After Stripe payment submission succeeds, redirect to /thank-you?payment_intent={paymentIntentId}.
dev1.context_needed: CartContext at src/context/CartContext.jsx exposes items array with shape [{id, name, price (cents), image_url, quantity}] and clearCart(). src/lib/stripe.js exports loadStripe initialised with VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY. Supabase Edge Function is invoked at: `${import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/create-payment-intent` with header `Authorization: Bearer ${import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY}`. ThankYou page at src/pages/ThankYou.jsx expects ?payment_intent= query param. Existing Checkout.jsx scaffold is at src/pages/Checkout.jsx — replace its contents.

dev2.task: Create the create-payment-intent Supabase Edge Function at supabase/functions/create-payment-intent/index.ts. Accept POST with JSON body {items: [{product_id: string, quantity: number}], customer: {name: string, email: string, street: string, city: string, postal_code: string, country: string}}. Steps in order: (1) fetch all referenced product rows from the products table using the service role Supabase client; (2) return 400 JSON {error: 'Product not found'} if any product_id is missing; (3) return 400 JSON {error: 'Item unavailable'} if any product has is_available = false; (4) calculate total in cents as sum of (product.price * item.quantity) — never use client-provided prices; (5) create a Stripe PaymentIntent in EUR for that total using STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (do NOT create a PI if any validation above failed); (6) insert one row into orders with columns: stripe_payment_id, status ('order_received'), total, customer_name, customer_email, shipping_street, shipping_city, shipping_postal_code, shipping_country; (7) insert one row into order_items per cart item with order_id, product_id, quantity, price_at_purchase (from DB); (8) return 200 JSON {clientSecret: pi.client_secret}. Write Jest/Deno tests covering all Edge Function acceptance criteria: 400 on missing product, 400 on unavailable product, correct total calculation, correct DB writes, clientSecret returned on success, no PI created on validation failure.
dev2.context_needed: DB schema — orders columns: id (uuid), stripe_payment_id (TEXT NOT NULL), status (TEXT: order_received|payment_confirmed|order_confirmed|sent|cancelled), total (INTEGER cents), customer_name, customer_email, shipping_street, shipping_city, shipping_postal_code, shipping_country, created_at. order_items columns: id, order_id (FK orders.id), product_id (FK products.id), quantity (INTEGER), price_at_purchase (INTEGER cents). products columns: id (uuid), name, is_available (BOOLEAN), price (INTEGER cents), tags (TEXT[]). RLS: orders INSERT/UPDATE only via service role key. Use Deno.env.get('STRIPE_SECRET_KEY') and Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY') + Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_URL') at runtime. Stripe PaymentIntent must be created in EUR. PI creation order: validate first, create PI second, insert orders row with stripe_payment_id = pi.id third, insert order_items fourth.
